snippet.title: METAL DOGS Gameplay PC
snippet.description:
METAL DOGS Gameplay PC

ABOUT THIS GAME

Set in a world after the destruction of humankind, the harsh battle of the combat dog "Pochi" begins. Explore dungeons that change every time you enter, get a wide variety of weapons, and power up your dog! Hunt the evil "WANTED"! Enjoy exhilarating battles casually in this shooting action game.

#ps5 
#pubgmobile
